acquisition.description: The Dirt Block is one of the most common blocks in Terraria, occurring naturally almost everywhere throughout the world.
The Stone Block is a type of block that is generated naturally in very large parts of the world.
Wood is a type of block that is generally obtained by cutting down trees using an axe or a chainsaw
Life Crystals can be found naturally placed in any area in the Underground layer and below, though they are fairly uncommon.
A Lens is a common crafting material that has a 1/3 (33.33%) chance to drop from Demon Eyes and Wandering Eyes.
The Vile Mushroom is a type of mushroom growing on Corrupt grass or Corrupt Jungle grass, where they can be cut and collected with a single swing from any weapon or tool.
Worm Tooth is a crafting material dropped by Devourers in The Corruption.
It has a 1/25 (4%) chance to drop from Skeletons, Undead Miners, Hoplites, and Undead Vikings in the Marble Caves, Ice biome, and Cavern layer.
It is found primarily in Surface-level (above 0 elevation) areas, and is more rare at the upper parts of the Underground.
Books are found placed on the Dungeon's many shelves, where they can be freed with a pickaxe or drill.
Cobwebs are commonly found in underground areas in clusters of 5 or more alongside the edges of walls or ceilings, and are guaranteed to drop a Cobweb item when broken
The Ash Block is a block that covers the upper and lower sections of The Underworld
Mud Blocks are a very common block type that comprises the majority of the Jungle, Underground Jungle, and Glowing Mushroom biome.
Sapphire is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world.
Ruby is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world.
Emerald is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world.
Topaz is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world.
Amethyst is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world.
Diamond is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world.
The Glowing Mushroom is a plant, crafting material, and block that can be found on Mushroom grass in the Glowing Mushroom biome.
It is obtained from Spiked Jungle Slimes, Hornets, and Moss Hornets found in the Underground Jungle biome.
Vines are crafting materials dropped by Man Eaters in the Underground Jungle biome with a 1/2 (50%) / 100% drop chance.
The Black Lens is a crafting material dropped by Demon Eyes and Wandering Eyes at a 1/100 (1%) chance.
Corals are crafting materials which can be found in the Ocean biomes at the ends of the world.
Cactus is a crafting material obtained by harvesting Cactus plants, using an axe or chainsaw just like with trees.
Daybloom is a type of herb that appears as a small yellow flower with a straight green stem.
Moonglow is a type of herb which appears as a bent stalk with a drooping blue-white flower.
Blinkroot is a type of herb that appears as stems with glowing dots.
It grows naturally on Ebonstone, Crimstone, Corrupt grass, Crimson grass, Corrupt Jungle grass, and Crimson Jungle grass.
Waterleaf is a type of herb which appears as a small, turquoise-colored sprout.
Fireblossom is a type of herb which appears as a small, magma-colored flower.
The Shark Fin is a crafting material that has a 19/20 (95%) chance of being dropped by Sharks and Orcas found in the Ocean biome
The Feather is a common crafting material dropped frequently by Harpies.
The Antlion Mandible is a crafting material dropped by Antlions, Antlion Larvae, Antlion Chargers, and Antlion Swarmers found in the Desert and Underground Desert biomes.
Jungle Spores are crafting materials acquired by destroying green glowing orbs that grow randomly on Jungle grass in the Underground Jungle, in or below the Cavern layer.
The Tattered Cloth is a crafting material that is always dropped by Goblin Scouts.
Silt Blocks are a type of soil blocks that generates in the Underground and Cavern layers, appearing more frequently at lower depths.
Snow Blocks are blocks found naturally-placed in the Snow biome.
Ebonwood is a type of wood harvested from Ebonwood trees and Ebonwood Palm trees found naturally growing in Corruption biomes.
Rich Mahogany is a type of wood harvested from Mahogany trees found naturally growing in the Jungle and Underground Jungle
Pearlwood is a Hardmode-exclusive[a] type of wood harvested from Pearlwood trees and Pearlwood Palm trees found naturally growing in Hallow biomes.
Ice Blocks are a common block type found alongside Snow Blocks in the Snow and Ice biomes.
Shadewood is a type of wood harvested from Shadewood trees and Shadewood Palm trees found naturally growing in Crimson biomes.
Amber is a gem found within the Underground Desert of a world.
